decision: An application must be registered through requestNew-Platform-Members before any landing zone is provisioned for it.
why: Without the profile there is no Entra ID group, invoice section, or repo for a landing zone to attach to.
steps: Collect the application name, owner email, and engineer email.
Present the values and wait for confirmation.
Dispatch requestNew-Platform-Members, which opens a PR creating platform-members/{AppName}.json.
A platform engineer reviews the PR. After merge, template-new-platform-members provisions the application repo, Entra group, billing scope, and repository variables.
violations: Platform member file created by hand instead of through the workflow.
